annotations.title: Import editable content from Shopify email code

description: Take pasted Shopify notification HTML or Liquid and extract literal text, approved images, and store links as editable blocks. Dry-run returns the selected blocks and skipped-content counts. Existing blocks and native Shopify logic stay in place. This action does not fetch or install a Shopify template.

dry_run.description: True validates without saving. False validates and saves one undoable change.

expected_seq.description: Latest workspace sequence returned by a read. A stale sequence is refused.

request_id.description: Unique ID for this change. Reuse it only when retrying the identical operation.

theme_id.description: An owned theme ID returned by list_themes, copy_theme or create_custom_theme.

name: import_email_content
title: Import editable content from Shopify email code
